strings.subtitle: — Umtshabalalisi weefayile —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Ukutsala nokuyeka akufumaneki. Sebenzisa iqhosha elingezantsi.
strings.shred_button: T S H A B A L A L I S A
strings.ssd_warning:
Isilumkiso! Kwi-SSD indlela yokubhala phezulu ayiqinisekisi ukutshatyalaliswa ngenxa ye-TRIM.
Le nkqubo yeye-HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ifayile "{name}" iya kubhalwa phezulu kwaye icinywe.

Qhubeka?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Esi sisikhetsho (.lnk). Sisikhetsho kuphela esiza kutshatyalaliswa.

Ifayile ekujoliswe kuyo esiyikhombayo iza kuhlala injalo.

Qhubeka?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Le yi-network drive (\\server\share).
Ukubhala phezu kwecandelo akuqinisekisi ukutshatyalaliswa — umncedisi unokuba ne-snapshot, deduplication okanye i-CoW.

Qhubeka?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Le yi-removable drive (USB / HDD yangaphandle).
Umlawuli unokugcina iibhloko ezindala kwindawo yokugcina.

Qhubeka?
strings.report_limits:
• Imisinga yedatha engenye ye-NTFS (ADS) ayisetyenzwa.
• Ijenali ye-USN ayicocwa.
• Iikopi zesithunzi kunye nongqamaniso lwamafu
  (OneDrive njl.njl.) azichatshazelwa.
strings.status_full: Umxholo ubhalwe phezulu ngokupheleleyo ngeziro. Ukubuyisela akunakwenzeka — izixhobo ziya kubona iziro kuphela.
strings.status_fast: Intloko, umsila kunye nemigca ye-4 MB ibhalwe phezulu. Okunye akuchatshazelwanga, kodwa ngenxa yezikhewu ukubuyisela okupheleleyo ngezixhobo zomsebenzisi akunakwenzeka. Kumaxwebhu afihlakeleyo sebenzisa imowudi EPHELELEYO.
strings.status_empty: Ifayile yayingenanto, ukubhala phezulu kwakungafuneki. Icinyiwe.
strings.error_permission: Ayikwazi ukufikelela kwifayile. Inokuba ivuliwe kwenye inkqubo. Yivale kwaye uzame kwakhona.
strings.error_is_symlink: Le yi-symbolic link. Iilink azikwazi ukutshatyalaliswa — ifayile ekujoliswe kuyo iza kuhlala injalo.
strings.error_reparse: Le yi-placeholder yefayile (OneDrive okanye efanayo). Idatha yayo igcinwe efini, hayi kwidiski — akukho nto iza kutshatyalaliswa apha.
strings.error_not_file: Le ayiyofayile (yifolda okanye enye into). Lahla ifayile.
strings.error_hardlinks: Le fayile inezinye ii-hard link ({n} zizonke). Ii-hard link azinayo eyona iphambili — onke amagama ayalingana. Ukuba utshabalalisa ngendlela yangoku, idatha iza kubhalwa phezu kwayo kwaye inqunyulwe ibe yi-32 bytes, kodwa intsalela iza kuhlala ifikeleleka ngezinye iilink. Cima zonke iilink kuqala.
strings.error_compressed:
Ifayile icinezelwe, iguqulwe ngokufihlakeleyo okanye i-sparse. Ukubhala ngo-zero akuqinisekisi ukutshatyalaliswa kwedatha endala kuba i-NTFS iyigcina ngendlela eyahlukileyo.

Susa i-attribute: cofa ngasekunene → Iimpawu → Ezandisiweyo → susa uphawu lwe 'Cinezela' kunye/okanye 'Fihla'. Emva koko sebenzisa i-SHREDDER kwakhona.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Iifayile ezi {count} ziza kutshatyalaliswa.
Ubungakanani bubonke: {size}.

Jonga uluhlu phambi kokuqhubeka.
Esi senzo asinakubuyiselwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Susa zonke iifayile ezi {count} kumgca?

Iifayile ngokwazo AZIYI KUPHATHWA — luluhlu kuphela.
strings.hardlink_text:
Ifayile "{name}" inezinye ii-hard link ({nlink} zizonke).

Idatha iza kutshatyalaliswa kuwo onke amagama.
Kodwa iintsalela (32 bytes) ziza kuhlala phantsi kwamanye amagama kwifolda.

Usenokudinga ukucima ezi ntsalela ngesandla.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Sebenzisa kuzo zonke ii-hard link kumgca
